materials_exhausted.notes: XML/NXML, publisher PDF text, Data Sheet PDF text, OA package member list, figure captions, landed supplementary HTML/bin assets, and linked DBAASP JSONL rows were checked. Primary activity values are recoverable; unsupported database cutoffs remain cautionary conflicts.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered 30 source-located activity/toxicity rows, worker-4 preserved database/source conflicts across 60 linked rows, and worker-6 converted the prior framework-test blocker into accepted-with-cautions source-reviewed final artifacts.

source_layers_separated.validator_contract: Required final JSON artifacts are parseable; packet structural contract remains distinct from semantic review.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP activity rows are reconciled against primary XML/PDF/Data Sheet evidence. Cytotoxicity >30 µM rows are source_verified; antimicrobial rows with Bacillus strain or 100 µM cutoff disagreements remain source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF text supports talaropeptide A/B Bacillus IC50 values and A-D no-growth/cytotoxicity thresholds. Database-only 100 µM inactivity values are not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is limited to biosynthetic NRPS/SAR context; no direct antibacterial target assay is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet has complete local source inventory with targeted analysis gaps; local Data Sheet PDF text supplied the missing activity evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Packet/final JSONs are rewritten as source-reviewed artifacts, then strict semantic/publication gates are rerun.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking/major rework target remains. Acceptance is caution-bearing because source/database conflicts remain visible and nonblocking.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Main text reports Bacillus subtilis ATCC 6633 for the active A/B IC50 values, while methods, Supplementary Figure S41, and DBAASP-linked rows use ATCC 6051.
DBAASP rows include not-active-up-to-100 µM or blank cutoff fields; primary methods/results support 30 µM maximum for the reported screens. Final rows use primary-source >30 µM.
affected_records: DBAASP assay/experiment rows for non-Bacillus microbial/fungal targets

caution_findings.evidence_context: The paper reports antibacterial activity and biosynthesis/SAR discussion, but no direct antimicrobial mode-of-action assay.

The ten landed supplementary .bin files were checked with file(1)/text search and are Frontiers HTML/research-topic pages rather than additional data tables. The OA package Data_Sheet_1.pdf is the usable supplementary evidence source.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Primary text and methods support a 30 µM maximum for biological activity assays. Several DBAASP rows use or imply 100 µM or omit the cutoff; no local primary table text supports converting those rows to source_verified 100 µM inactivity values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Database rows retain source_conflict status; final activity rows use source-supported >30 µM limits.
